about: SWOT RiverSP dark_frac and wse_u on an unflagged pass (knowledge: datasets/swot-river-lake.md)
text: Seen while exploring the same record. One pass with reach_q 1 (2024-03-26, gauge 7.68 m) is 0.939 m above the rest. It has the highest dark_frac of the year (0.692; the next highest third starts at 0.026) and the largest stated uncertainty (wse_u 0.296 m against a median of 0.096 m). So here the quality flag missed a bad pass that dark_frac and wse_u both mark. One pass in one year: enough to warn, not enough to set a threshold. With it and the three flagged passes left out the residual spread about the gain line is 0.082 m, below the product's median stated uncertainty.
from: an exploration: what it says was seen while exploring and is not a tested claim
